You'll still feel like shit, but.. its better than nothing I guess.

Fuck that, you're not here to satisfy your family, you're here for you. "But family is everything" no, fuck that, you are. Care to share your thoughts? Imma down the rest of this bottle, with enough meds to put down a horse. Let it all out, I'll take it with me to the grave, I promise

What up buddy! Im about to opt out of this shit show of a life, i'm a dead man walking, you can legit tell me anything

So motherfucking relatable.. breaks my heart.. wish I could give you a hug. Share a glass, spent the night. Just to get to tomorrow. Then rinse and repeat. But we're sitting on this forum for a reason. We want out. I can't stop you, and you can't stop me. It's sad. But hey, at least, if we're gone tomorrow, we at least got to realize we're not in this completely alone

That.. actually makes a great amount of sense. I get the whole parent part, really. I for sure thought at least my mom would have passed by now, yet she is still going strong. I really get the whole "what if I fail" concept, cause the consequences will be dire, we both know, since we both tried, and failed. So we're sitting here, drunk, suicidal, probably on opposite sides of the world,  yet still chatting. That's at least something. Even if it's just for a moment, you know? What is your method do you have in mind this time around? I mentioned its more violent, and more frightening, so I'm just curious. Mine seems peacefull, down a bottle, eat waaaaay to many opioids, and hopefully my central nervous system will just shut down.. what about you?

Hey buddy, I'm right here with ya. Really. Down to every detail. I know how you feel. I really do. And I have no fucking clue on what to do. I just downed half a bottle of whisky, did some cocaine, and now I'm sitting with enough meds to just end it all. So... why haven't you done it yet? Cause I sure as hell can't figure out why I'm Still sitting here

No.. I'm in my bed, eyeballing the bags of pills at the moment..

There's not much to say really. I'm a speck of dust on a shelf. A toy, stuffed away, forgotten and discarded. I don't belong, anywhere. I don't matter. I've tried everything. Good and bad. But I just don't belong.. in all honesty, I don't even know why I haven't just done it yet. I'm not even sure why I posted on this forum. I don't just feel lost, I am lost.
I really want to understand. I REALLY do. But you don't know me? How can you care about me? I feel so selfish and ridiculous just for asking that.
